svg.text: tb_mpdda_dc: DC transfer of d2s_mpdda, tt 27 C, load 1 kOhm to vref || 100 pF
DUT and bias from the schematics in this directory; code block = the deck's .lib/.param/.save lines and its .control section
meas dc vop find vo at=0.2
meas dc von find vo at=-0.2
meas dc off find vo at=0
meas dc iqp find ip at=0
meas dc iqn find in at=0
meas dc iddq find idd at=0
print gain off nonlin iqp iqn iddq
